findings.evidence: probeStorage calls probeValidatedStorage without an injected factory, which falls back to globalThis.indexedDB in isolated runtimes.
findings.violated: ADR 0003 explicit-dependency rule and deterministic adapter requirement
findings.issue: Application storage probing retains an ambient browser dependency.
findings.remediation: Inject a storage-probe adapter or move probing behind Match Store and cover success/failure through the application interface.

findings.evidence: The report has successful graph evidence but no exact temporary Svelte-cycle failure command/result.
findings.issue: Required negative proof is not durably recorded.
findings.remediation: Record the exact temporary-cycle failure and clean rerun in feature evidence.

findings.evidence: pull_request executes PR-controlled install/check steps after checkout without persist-credentials: false.
findings.issue: PR-controlled code may access checkout credentials during workflow execution.
Upstream tag movement can change executed action code.
findings.remediation: Pin actions to full commit SHAs.

blockers: Approve or revise the bounded remediation batch before Review continues.
